title: Weather Advisory System
title_vi: Thử Thách: Hệ Thống Cảnh Báo Thời Tiết
overview: Implement a weather advisory script using nested conditions.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice the reviewed shell concepts below. Instructions are independently written; functional requirements follow the linked public lesson.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành các khái niệm shell bên dưới. Hướng dẫn được biên soạn lại; yêu cầu chức năng theo bài công khai được liên kết.
sections.hint: Thực hiện theo yêu cầu và kiểm tra kết quả trên hệ thống.

sections.title: Complete the Weather Advisory Script
sections.title_vi: Hoàn thiện kịch bản tư vấn thời tiết
sections.content:
Complete the provided weather_advisor.sh. Read Celsius from stdin; handle <0, 0–10, 11–20 and >20. Preserve the four source advice strings shown below.

- `-2` → `It's freezing! Wear a heavy coat and gloves.`
- `0` → `It's cold. A warm jacket is recommended.`
- `10` → `It's cold. A warm jacket is recommended.`
- `11` → `It's cool. A light jacket should suffice.`
- `20` → `It's cool. A light jacket should suffice.`
- `21` → `It's warm. Enjoy the pleasant weather!`
sections.content_vi:
Hoàn thiện weather_advisor.sh có sẵn. Đọc độ C từ stdin; xử lý <0, 0–10, 11–20 và >20. Giữ bốn thông báo trong mã dưới đây.

- `-2` → `It's freezing! Wear a heavy coat and gloves.`
- `0` → `It's cold. A warm jacket is recommended.`
- `10` → `It's cold. A warm jacket is recommended.`
- `11` → `It's cool. A light jacket should suffice.`
- `20` → `It's cool. A light jacket should suffice.`
- `21` → `It's warm. Enjoy the pleasant weather!`

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/weather_advisor.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['read', 'if']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in []),result.stdout
    for number, expected in [(-2, "It's freezing! Wear a heavy coat and gloves."), (0, "It's cold. A warm jacket is recommended."), (10, "It's cold. A warm jacket is recommended."), (11, "It's cool. A light jacket should suffice."), (20, "It's cool. A light jacket should suffice."), (21, "It's warm. Enjoy the pleasant weather!")]:
        assert expected in execute([str(p)], str(number)+'\n').stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Review your scripts and retry their edge cases. Passing these local checks does not certify source-private grader parity.
sections.content_vi: Ôn lại script và thử trường hợp biên. Đạt bộ kiểm tra local không có nghĩa đã phục hồi bộ chấm riêng của nguồn.
